title: serratula glauca
intro: Serratula glauca, commonly known as Blue Carrot or White Carrot, is a perennial plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Serratula glauca include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and treat digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
